definitions.explanation: The language spoken in South Korea. This is the standard term used in Japan when referring to the Korean language in the context of South Korea.

examples.japanese: {韓国語|かんこくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
{韓国語|かんこくご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: I became able to introduce myself in Korean.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{韓国語|かんこくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}び→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧{始|はじ}める⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more young people are starting to learn Korean because of the influence of Korean dramas.

notes:
{韓国語|かんこくご} is composed of ⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：19417_kankoku⟧ (South Korea) + ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (language). This is the most common term in Japan for referring to the Korean language in everyday conversation, particularly when associated with South Korea.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {韓国語|かんこくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: speak Korean
- {韓国語|かんこくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: learn Korean
- {韓国語|かんこくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: Korean language class
- {韓国語|かんこくご}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: Korean language proficiency test (TOPIK)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝鮮語|ちょうせんご}: Korean language — the term associated with the Korean Peninsula as a whole or with North Korea; used in academic and linguistic contexts
- ハングル: Hangul — strictly refers to the Korean writing system, but in Japan it is sometimes loosely used to mean the Korean language itself

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, both {韓国語|かんこくご} and {朝鮮語|ちょうせんご} refer to the same language, but the choice of term carries political connotations. Universities and NHK sometimes use {朝鮮語|ちょうせんご} or ハングル as neutral alternatives.
